signature.one_line: Zero-cut speaker-over-listener split; glowing three-tier seam captions with one accent key word.
unique_devices: Three-tier glowing stack on the split seam: thin light white lead words above, one heavy accent black-weight key word with a accent halo exactly on the seam, a small heavy white follow-on word below
Letter-by-letter fade-out running left to right (~4 frames) while key words blur-fade in over ~6 frames; no hard text cuts at all
Zero picture cuts: a permanent 50/50 vertical split (speaker top, reacting listener bottom); attention reset by swapping the top panel to a second voice at ~60 % runtime
Dark warm low-key grade chosen so the accent glow is the brightest thing in frame
signature.why_it_works: A face is always reacting on screen so no cuts are needed; captions on the seam never cover a face and the accent key word gives a rhythmic visual beat.

hook.first_frame: 50/50 vertical split: guest at a microphone against a warm slatted wall on top, host listening in dark clothing below; thin white lead words glowing on the seam

structure.what: soft contrarian claim; accent key word every ~1.5-2 s
sarcastic counter-example of the opposite advice
top panel swaps to a second voice reinforcing the point

pacing.pace: single continuous composition (split screen, one panel swap)

captions.what: three-tier seam stack: light lead / accent key / small heavy follow-on
captions.how: centred; lead centre y 45.1 %, key centre 50.1-50.7 % (on the seam), small word 54.1 %; lead Inter 300 65 px white glow; key Poppins 900 133 px accent with halo; small Poppins 800 47 px; lead words fade in ~3 frames, key blur+fade ~6 frames, small ~4 frames; stack clears with a left-to-right letter fade ~4 frames

layout.what: 50/50 vertical split, speaker top / listener bottom
layout.how: two MCU panels each 50 % H, seam at 50 % H with no visible divider; top panel content swaps once at ~59 %

transitions.how: hard cut inside the top panel only; bottom listener continues

grouping.sync: word-by-word; lead words appear on their words, the key word on its word, the small word after it
grouping.break: the stack clears (letter-by-letter fade-out) before the next phrase

layout.lines_without_key: lead line alone stays at ~45 % (or drops to ~50 % on the seam when it is the only line, estimated)
layout.1080x1920_mapping: same percentages (9:16); designed for a 50/50 vertical split, speaker top / listener bottom

lead.letterform_evidence: Montserrat: wide round S and o, flat-topped t, double-storey a, very thin even strokes
lead.calibration_note: a 3-word sentence-case lead line measured 2.19 % H / 26.9 % W over a dark top (clean; words withheld)
lead.shadow: soft white outer glow, ~9 px @1080 (e.g. 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.55), estimated)

key.letterform_evidence: Montserrat Black: double-storey a, wide e with horizontal bar, flat t top, very heavy stems
key.calibration_note: on the seam (clean, gold-only ink); a 7-letter word with a descender measured 4.69 % H / 52.2 % W
key.shadow: soft gold glow around the word (blurred halo ~12 px @1080, e.g. 0 0 21px rgba(234,184,39,.6), estimated)

small.font_class: heavy display sans with ink-trap notches (stencil-like cuts in e, s, o)

animation.lead_entry: each word fades in over ~3 frames with a light blur, roughly on its word
animation.key_entry: blur + fade in over ~6 frames (dim and blurred first, full and sharp after ~6 frames); no scale
animation.small_entry: fades in over ~4 frames right after the key
animation.exit: letter-by-letter fade-out running left to right over ~4 frames, lead first while the key/small stay a little longer
animation.timing_note: time entries to the audio; automatic transcripts can drop repeated filler words

other_text_spec.text: none; the split-screen layout and captions carry the video

lead.closest_local: Inter 300 (Montserrat Light is the original feel)

style.look_intent: dark, warm, moody low-key studio; saturated rust/orange walls, deep blacks, low contrast mids, natural skin

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Kinetic Typography
catalog_styles.role: three-tier glowing stack with letter fade-out

use_when: Two-camera podcast or interview footage with a visibly reacting listener
Few or no usable cut points; the clip should play as one continuous take
A calm, reflective or contrarian opinion where key words deserve a gentle emphasis
Dark or moody footage where a glowing warm accent will pop
avoid_when: Single-camera footage (no listener for the bottom panel)
Bright, white or pastel sets where the glow and white thin text lose contrast
Fast hype edits needing punch-ins and graphics
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B44 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B44.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 29.97/30 fps. Two-camera conversation as a 50/50 vertical split: speaker top, listener bottom, seam at 50 % H.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} key word must stay >= 3:1 and be the brightest saturated element on the footage; thin {{TEXT}} lead words need a dark area behind them)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF (lead and small words)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #EAB827 (key word + its glow)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: none
- {{SURFACE}}: none (footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}: none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Poppins 900 (key word; Montserrat Black is the original feel)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 300 (lead words; Montserrat Light preferred); small words Poppins 800
- {{HANDLE}}: not on screen
- {{LOGO}}: none

CAPTIONS (three-tier seam stack)
1. Latin, as spoken; lead words sentence case, key and small words lowercase; no punctuation except apostrophes; no emoji.
2. Per phrase: 1-3 lead words, 0-1 key word (the stressed word), 0-2 small follow-on words.
3. Lead: {{FONT_BODY}} at 65 px, {{TEXT}}, soft white glow 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.55), centred at 45.1 % H.
4. Key: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 133 px, {{ACCENT}}, tracking -0.01em, soft halo 0 0 21px of {{ACCENT}} at 60 % opacity, centred ON the seam at 50.1-50.7 % H.
5. Small: Poppins 800 at 47 px, {{TEXT}}, soft glow, centred at 54.1 % H.
6. Motion (30 fps): lead words fade in ~3 frames with light blur on their words; key word blur+fade in over ~6 frames (no scale); small word fades in ~4 frames after the key; the stack clears with a left-to-right letter-by-letter fade over ~4 frames before the next phrase. No hard text cuts, no idle motion.

LAYOUT AND EDIT DEVICES
7. No picture cuts: keep the split for the whole piece. At ~60 % of runtime swap the top panel to a second voice/angle (cut inside the panel only).
8. No titles, lower-thirds, b-roll, punch-ins or end card.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: dark, warm, moody low-key, saturated warm walls, deep blacks, natural skin.
SOUND: voice only, trimmed to the first word (~4 frames), -14 LUFS (source sits slightly under, -14.6).

VERIFY
a) Render the key word "not" at 133 px on the seam and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.3,0.47,0.7,0.54 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:70"   (default ink #EAB827)
   Required: 4.61 % ±0.5 of H, 21.5 % ±2 of W, centre y ~50.4 %.
b) Small word "person" at 47 px: --box 0.3,0.52,0.7,0.565 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" -> 1.72 % ±0.5 H, 16.8 % ±2 W.
c) Lead line: render "KEY WORD" in {{FONT_BODY}} at 65 px at 45.1 % H; expected ink from video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word <word> (a 3-word lowercase-ish line ~2.2 % H).
